{{Short description|Japanese mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=August 2021}}
{{Use list-defined references|date=August 2021}}
'''Reiko Sakamoto''' ({{langx|ja|坂本 礼子}}, born 1939) is a Japanese mathematician affiliated with [[Nara Women's University]].{{r|dnb}} Her teachers have included [[Sigeru Mizohata]] and 
Masaya Yamaguchi;{{r|preface}} her students have included Yoshihiro Shibata.{{r|shibata}} She is known for her research on [[mixed boundary condition]]s for [[hyperbolic partial differential equation]]s,{{r|mixed}} for which she won the 1974 Iyanaga Prize of the [[Mathematical Society of Japan]],{{r|iyanaga}} and for her book on hyperbolic [[boundary value problem]]s.{{r|book}}
